subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Should Amazon Bedrock treat `agents.defaults.models[...].params.modelId` as the AWS `ConverseStreamCommand.modelId`, require discovered or explicitly configured model ids/ARNs as the canonical model id, or add a Bedrock-named wire-id parameter instead?
rationale: The choice affects provider identity semantics, config compatibility, discovery/catalog rows, full ARN model refs, and the shape of live verification; automation should not invent that contract.

options.title: Honor `params.modelId`
options.body: Use the existing per-model params value as the Bedrock wire model id, then add docs, unit coverage, cron-model coverage, and live Bedrock proof for this contract.

options.title: Require canonical model ids
options.body: Do not make generic params an identity override; instead require discovered inference-profile ids or explicit model rows, and document how ARN-like refs must be registered.

options.title: Add Bedrock-named wire id
options.body: Introduce a provider-owned `bedrockModelId` or `wireModelId` parameter if maintainers think generic `modelId` is too ambiguous for request identity.

recommendation.title: Honor `params.modelId`
recommendation.body: Use the existing per-model params value as the Bedrock wire model id, then add docs, unit coverage, cron-model coverage, and live Bedrock proof for this contract.

likelyOwner.reason: wirjo authored the closest merged inference-profile discovery work, making them the best initial owner for the Bedrock identity contract choice.
